data.long_meaning: Shamrao is a Sanskrit and Marathi name, derived from the Hindu mythology. This name is believed to be a reference to the deity Shri Shamara, who is the god of wealth and prosperity. The name carries the blessings of the divine deity and is considered an auspicious name for a baby boy. The name Shamrao carries the meaning “God of Wealth” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Shamrao usually hope their child will grow to embody god of wealth and live with faith, good character and purpose.

It is often considered an honorable and prestigious name for a boy, as it is associated with Shri Shamara, the prosperity god. Moreover, the name has its origins in Hindu mythology, which adds to its cultural significance and appeals to Hindu families.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Shamrao carries profound significance. It is believed that the name invokes the blessings of Lord Shri Shamara, who is associated with abundance, prosperity, and wealth. The name is often bestowed upon a child with the hope that they will be blessed with these qualities and lead a prosperous life.
